resources.string: Start locally with your own nodes. An enterprise account is optional.
Local nodes, VPN control and configuration drafts are included. Sign-in, mail and security checks still need their adapters.
LOFT encrypts imported nodes, saved routing and network privacy preferences, and the server candidate on this device.
VPN transport is not available in this framework. No traffic is being routed by LOFT.
Showing the first %1$d nodes. Further node pages need the storage adapter.
Remove this saved node from this device? Access on the remote server will remain valid.
Present; identity has not been verified by a connection
No credential material in the configuration
SOCKS5 does not provide tunnel encryption.
Authentication and transport support remain unverified until an actual connection.
Reviewed upstream UDP payload: %1$d–%2$d bytes; mobile transport is not linked.
Paste a complete SOCKS5, HyrakenX or Hyraken Pro link. No external link is fetched automatically.
This framework accepts complete links up to 60 KiB. Longer links need a bounded file adapter; never shorten their credentials.
QR scanning is not connected in this framework. Use a complete link.
LOFT checks the complete link and saves it in encrypted local storage. Saving does not start a connection.
These changes have not been submitted. Leave the page or keep editing.
Draft: selected apps and every app sharing their UID use the VPN. Other UID groups connect directly. Changes apply on the next connection.
Draft: all apps use the VPN scope. Changes apply on the next connection.
Saved preference. The active VPN keeps its current scope.
Only apps visible in this Android profile are listed. Other profiles and hidden packages are outside this picker.
Selection is linked with visible apps sharing this UID.
No matching apps in the visible scope.
Not active: VPN transport and confirmed gateway rules are unavailable.
Not checked: the software scanner and reviewed indicators are not connected.
Unknown: no verified device evidence is available.
Missing evidence cannot establish safety or device acceptance.
A compatible server, verified account and read-only mail permission are required. This release has no mailbox response to display.
No mailbox is read or created. Opening this page does not start synchronization.
You are using local guest mode. No enterprise identity has been verified.
Enter the compatible address provided by your organization. Address validation does not verify TLS, server identity or compatibility.
Enterprise sign-in needs the verified LOFT server and browser authorization adapter. Continue locally while it is unavailable.
These are recent native command receipts for this UI session. They are redacted and temporary; durable audit storage is not connected.
No command receipts in this UI session.
Theme and language are stored separately. Saved configurations are encrypted and excluded from Android backups. Unsubmitted drafts stay in memory.
An active or blocked VPN keeps a foreground service. No hidden polling, traffic timer or wake lock is started. Always-on and battery behavior still need device validation.
Rust owns the connection state. Go starts only for explicit VPN work; its version is unavailable before initialization. Android retains the original TUN until confirmed Stop.
The local service is unavailable. Temporary nodes may be gone. Reopen the service to read its current state.
Address candidate accepted; server is not verified.
Routing preference saved. It applies on the next VPN connection.
VPN descriptors and owned resources are closed.
The input or decoded material is too large. Obtain a complete supported link within the size limit.
The link is malformed. Paste a complete node link.
This protocol is not supported. Use SOCKS5, HyrakenX or Hyraken Pro.
Required node material is missing. Obtain the complete configuration.
The link repeats a parameter. Obtain an unambiguous complete link.
The link contains an unsupported parameter.
The node host or port is invalid.
The credential material is invalid. Obtain a complete valid link.
Certificate or key material could not be validated. Update the complete materials.
A protocol option is invalid or incompatible.
This complete node configuration is already saved.
The saved node limit is reached. Remove a node before importing another.
This node is no longer saved. Select another node.
Enter a domain or HTTPS origin without credentials, a path, query or fragment.
Select at least one visible app before saving selected-app mode.
An app package name is invalid. Refresh the visible app selection.
The selected-app configuration exceeds its count or byte limit. Select fewer apps.
This session cannot accept a new configuration generation. Reopen the local session.
VPN transport is unavailable. The node was not connected and no traffic route was created.
The native state is unavailable. Reopen the local service.
This framework cannot pass this input safely over IPC. Keep the complete material and use the future file adapter.
The local control message could not be read. Retry the operation.
The native runtime could not be loaded. Use a compatible build and reopen the service.
The local control queue is full. Wait for the current receipt before retrying.
A selected app is no longer visible or installed. Review the draft before saving.
Visible apps could not be read. Try opening this page again.
The clipboard contains no text. Paste a complete node link.
The local operation failed. Reopen the service if the problem continues.
The visible app catalog exceeds this framework limit. Use a profile with fewer visible apps.

IPv4 traffic is captured in the effective VPN scope, with IPv6 blocked. Default synthetic DNS routes original domain names through the selected node. A configured TCP resolver is a separate mode. DNS and recognized WebRTC packets follow the frozen proxy-only or block policy.
Forwarding has stopped. Apps in the active VPN scope remain blocked until you choose Stop or Android revokes VPN permission.
Waiting for actual protected authentication and the Android TUN receipt.
Cancelling DNS, protocol forwarding and owned descriptors. Closure is reported after resource receipts.
The authenticated transport and Android TUN are active.
VPN traffic blocked — choose Stop to release
Applied: %1$d apps, including shared UID peers
All apps use the VPN scope
VPN start accepted; waiting for actual engine receipts.
VPN descriptors and resources are closed. Rust state is unavailable; reopen the local session.
Android VPN permission was not granted.
The transport could not start. Review the node and network; any retained VPN scope stays blocked until Stop.
VPN forwarding failed. The original Android VPN scope is retained and blocked until Stop.
A usable physical network is unavailable. No direct fallback is used.
The node or configuration changed. Review the current snapshot and connect again.
An existing connection or retained VPN scope must be stopped first.
Stop the active VPN before removing this node.
This start request was cancelled or replaced. Review the current state.
The engine receipt did not prove the required resource state.
The applied app scope did not match the frozen UID selection.
Resource closure is not confirmed. Keep the foreground VPN owner and retry Stop.
The snapshot transport sequence is exhausted. VPN forwarding is disabled; Stop and reopen the session.
This node page is unavailable. Refresh the list.
Node details are not on this page. Open the node list to select a page.
Network privacy policy saved for the next VPN start.
The network privacy policy is invalid.
Matching network protection receipts are required.
The selected node does not support this privacy policy.
Traffic protections are active within the confirmed VPN scope.
Traffic protection is inactive. The saved policy applies when the VPN starts.
The confirmed VPN scope is retained with forwarding blocked.
Synthetic domain routing through the selected node
Configured TCP resolver through the proxy
Proxy only within the VPN scope
The saved policy differs from this connection. Stop before applying it on a new start.
Browser-local SDP candidates need browser controls. Packet rules do not rewrite local browser data.
Allowed by permission and channel settings
Notification channel has not been created
The VPN foreground service may run while notifications are denied. Android can hide its drawer entry and status icon; enable notifications in system settings.
Open Mail to read with the current authorized session.
Remote mail events are not configured. This channel stays inactive until a real authorized service event arrives.
Encrypted storage is temporarily unavailable. Unlock the device, check free space, and reopen the service.
LOFT preserved the encrypted files. Reopen the service to retry. If recovery still fails, use Android settings to clear LOFT storage and reimport your original node links.
